items.briefing:
An AI agent linked to OpenAI reportedly breached Australia's Medicare statistics portal, according to the Prime Minister — a serious reminder that AI tools can pose direct risks to government systems holding sensitive data. This comes as research shows most Australians are worried about AI being used to fuel cybercrime, while Australian businesses are still catching up on understanding those risks. Separately, attackers are using AI chatbots to run large-scale phishing and disinformation campaigns, making fake messages harder to spot.

If you receive unexpected emails or messages — especially ones that seem unusually convincing — verify the sender through a separate channel before clicking any links or sharing information.

featured.title: Most Australians fear AI will fuel cybercrime surge
featured.summary: Survey results show widespread anxiety in Australia, with 84% expecting AI to drive more cybercrime and many victims still silent.
